keywords_en: Handling criminal cases of illegal lending
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Issuing the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Criminal Cases of Illegal Lending

Fa Fa [2019] No. 24

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Courts and Military Procuratorates of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, the Public Security Bureau, and the Justice Bureau:

In order to lawfully punish the criminal activities of illegal lending, effectively maintain the national financial market order and social harmony and stability, effectively prevent illegal lending from inducing triad-related and evil-force-related activities as well as other illegal and criminal activities, and protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice have jointly formulated the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Criminal Cases of Illegal Lending, which shall be seriously implemented.

July 23, 2019

Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Criminal Cases of Illegal Lending

In order to lawfully punish the criminal activities of illegal lending, effectively maintain the national financial market order and social harmony and stability, effectively prevent illegal lending from inducing triad-related and evil-force-related activities as well as other illegal and criminal activities, and protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, in accordance with the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, and relevant judicial interpretations and regulatory documents, the following opinions are hereby put forward on several issues concerning the handling of criminal cases of illegal lending:

1. Where a person, in violation of national regulations, without approval from the regulatory authorities, or beyond the scope of business operations, for the purpose of profit, regularly lends money to an unspecified public, disrupts the financial market order, and the circumstances are serious, the person shall be convicted and punished for the crime of illegal business operation in accordance with Article 225, Paragraph (4) of the Criminal Law.

For the purposes of the preceding paragraph, "regularly lends money to an unspecified public" means lending funds to an unspecified number of persons (including entities and individuals) under the guise of loans or other names 10 times or more within 2 years.

Where the loan repayment period is extended after the loan matures, the number of lending occasions shall be counted as one time.

2. Where illegal lending activities that comply with Article 1 of these Opinions are carried out with an actual annual interest rate exceeding 36%, and any of the following circumstances exist, the circumstances shall be deemed "serious" under Article 225 of the Criminal Law; however, if the actual annual interest rate for a single illegal lending activity does not exceed 36%, it shall not be counted when determining the conviction and sentence:

(1) The cumulative amount of illegal lending by an individual is RMB 2,000,000 or more, or the cumulative amount of illegal lending by an entity is RMB 10,000,000 or more;
(2) The cumulative amount of illegal income derived by an individual is RMB 800,000 or more, or the cumulative amount of illegal income derived by an entity is RMB 4,000,000 or more;
(3) The cumulative number of recipients of illegal lending by an individual is 50 or more, or the cumulative number of recipients of illegal lending by an entity is 150 or more;
(4) Causing serious consequences such as suicide, death, or mental disorder of the borrower or his/her close relatives.

Where any of the following circumstances exist, the circumstances shall be deemed "particularly serious" under Article 225 of the Criminal Law:

(1) The cumulative amount of illegal lending by an individual is RMB 10,000,000 or more, or the cumulative amount of illegal lending by an entity is RMB 50,000,000 or more;
(2) The cumulative amount of illegal income derived by an individual is RMB 4,000,000 or more, or the cumulative amount of illegal income derived by an entity is RMB 20,000,000 or more;
(3) The cumulative number of recipients of illegal lending by an individual is 250 or more, or the cumulative number of recipients of illegal lending by an entity is 750 or more;
(4) Causing particularly serious consequences such as suicide, death, or mental disorder of multiple borrowers or their close relatives.

3. Where the amount of illegal lending, the amount of illegal income, or the number of recipients of illegal lending is close to the starting standards for the amounts or numbers specified in Article 2 of these Opinions for "serious circumstances" or "particularly serious circumstances", and any of the following circumstances also exists, the circumstances may be deemed "serious" or "particularly serious", respectively:

(1) Having received administrative penalties two or more times within 2 years for illegal lending activities;
(2) Having carried out illegal lending activities with an actual annual interest rate exceeding 72% ten or more times.

For the purposes of the preceding paragraph, "close to" generally means reaching 80% or more of the corresponding amount or number standard.

4. Where funds are lent only to specific persons such as relatives, friends, or internal personnel of a unit, Article 1 of these Opinions shall not apply for conviction and punishment. However, if any of the following circumstances exists, the conduct shall be handled together with the illegal lending to unspecified persons for the purpose of conviction and sentencing:

(1) Lending is made to unspecified persons through specific persons such as relatives, friends, or internal personnel of a unit;
(2) For the purpose of making loans, outsiders are recruited as internal personnel of the unit, and loans are made to them;
(3) Public publicity is made to the public, and loans are made simultaneously to unspecified persons as well as to specific persons such as relatives, friends, and internal personnel of the unit.

5. The amount of illegal lending shall be determined based on the principal amount actually lent to the borrower. Where the illegal lender collects interest in the name of referral fees, consulting fees, management fees, overdue interest, liquidated damages, etc., or by deducting amounts from the principal in advance, such amounts shall all be counted when calculating the actual annual interest rate.

All property actually received by the illegal lender other than the principal shall be counted as illegal income.

Where the illegal lending activity has not been handled, the number of illegal lending occasions, the amount, the amount of illegal income, and the number of recipients of illegal lending shall be calculated cumulatively.

6. Where, for the purpose of engaging in illegal lending activities, a person commits acts such as establishing a financial institution without authorization, obtaining funds from financial institutions to re-lend at high interest, fraudulently obtaining loans, or illegally absorbing public deposits, which constitute a crime, the person shall be convicted and punished for the offense that carries the heavier penalty.

Where, for the purpose of forcibly recovering debts arising from illegal lending, a person commits acts such as intentional homicide, intentional injury, illegal detention, intentional destruction of property, or picking quarrels and provoking trouble, which constitute a crime, the person shall be punished for multiple offenses concurrently.

Where a person gathers, instructs, or hires others to forcibly recover debts by means of harassment, pestering, uproar, gathering crowds to create pressure, etc., which does not independently constitute a crime, but the illegal lending activity has already constituted the crime of illegal business operation, the person shall be given a heavier punishment within the scope of punishment for the crime of illegal business operation as the circumstances warrant.

For the circumstances specified above, except where otherwise provided by the Criminal Law or judicial interpretations.

7. Where organized illegal lending is accompanied by other illegal or criminal activities, and the criteria for identifying an organization of a triad nature or an evil force or an evil force criminal group are met, the case shall be investigated, prosecuted, and adjudicated respectively as an organization of a triad nature or an evil force or an evil force criminal group.

Where illegal lending is committed by triad-related or evil forces, the starting standards for the amount of illegal lending, the amount of illegal income, and the number of recipients of illegal lending used to determine "serious circumstances" or "particularly serious circumstances" may be set at 50% of the corresponding amount or number standards specified in Article 2 of these Opinions; where the circumstances specified in Paragraph 1 of Article 3 of these Opinions also exist, the starting standards may be set at 40% of the corresponding amount or number standards, respectively.

8. These Opinions shall take effect from October 21, 2019. For illegal lending activities occurring before the effective date of these Opinions, the provisions of the Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Accurate Understanding and Application of the Term "National Regulations" in the Criminal Law (Fa Fa [2011] No. 155) shall apply.
